meaning.en: Sort of short, short to a degree, moderately short.

sentences.en: Yugoslav fresco and beyond, St. Peter is always portrayed with curly, shortish hair and a rounded white beard.

sentences.en: Rigid norms for wage growth cannot last indefinitely, tho they can help for a shortish time during disinflation.

sentences.en: Watson has shown, is hardly distinguishable; (2) Eudyptes, in which the bill is much shorter and rather broad; and (3) Spheniscus, in which the shortish bill is compressed and the maxilla ends in a conspicuous hook.

sentences.en: The endomorph is round and soft, with shortish limbs, and small, plump hands and feet.
